title: Birthday Boy said: “Best Birthday Present Ever!”
text:
We bought a subscription as a birthday gift for a kid and he loves it! One of “the best birthday presents ever!”

We ordered Marvel & DC, and sent a note indicating age of recipient, and asked Comic Garage (CG) if they could help us choose.

We consulted younger brother for birthday kid’s current superhero faves (changes weekly), and CG even sent one of each!

Excellent, friendly customer service. Super fast shipping. Thank you so much! So happy we ordered this. :)
label: positive
